description: Bake a claude onboarding + /workspace folder-trust config into the cam-worker image so interactive container workers do not block on first-run prompts.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed: a COPY without --chown creates files owned by UID:GID 0 (root); a later RUN chown -R changes ownership of earlier-copied files at that path; ARG takes effect from its declaration line onward. Validates placing the COPY to /home/bun/.claude.json BEFORE the ARG HOST_UID re-home block, whose chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /home/bun re-owns the copied file to the host uid without a --chown flag.

userStories.title: Bake claude onboarding + /workspace trust config into the cam-worker image
userStories.description: As a container-mode operator, I need the claude first-run onboarding and /workspace folder-trust state pre-seeded in the worker image so that interactive docker exec workers reach the agent with zero blocking prompts (no theme picker, no trust-this-folder dialog).
acceptanceCriteria: `.devcontainer/claude-config.json` exists and parses as JSON with exactly the five required keys: top-level hasCompletedOnboarding=true, theme="dark", bypassPermissionsModeAccepted=true, and projects["/workspace"] with hasTrustDialogAccepted=true and hasCompletedProjectOnboarding=true. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/claude-config-bake.test.ts]

`.devcontainer/Dockerfile` adds `COPY .devcontainer/claude-config.json /home/bun/.claude.json` with no `--chown` flag and adds no extra chown line for it, relying on the existing `chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /home/bun` in the re-home block to re-own it. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'COPY .devcontainer/claude-config.json /home/bun/.claude.json' .devcontainer/Dockerfile]

The COPY of claude-config.json to /home/bun/.claude.json is positioned BEFORE the `ARG HOST_UID` line in the Dockerfile, so the CAM-178 re-home chown re-owns it to the host uid. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/claude-config-bake.test.ts]

A new unit test (mirroring test/supervisor/worker-container-git-cred.test.ts: readFileSync file-asserts, no Docker daemon) asserts (a) claude-config.json parses to the exact five-key shape and (b) the Dockerfile COPY to /home/bun/.claude.json appears before the `ARG HOST_UID` line. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'ARG HOST_UID' test/supervisor/claude-config-bake.test.ts]

The image bake introduces no run-argv change: src/supervisor/worker-container.ts and src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts have no diff versus main, and the claude-code-config volume mount at /home/bun/.claude in buildDockerRunArgv is untouched. [oracle: git diff --exit-code main -- src/supervisor/worker-container.ts src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Two file edits + one new test; WSJF jobSize 2 (mechanical, single concern). (1) NEW `.devcontainer/claude-config.json`: exactly five keys — top-level hasCompletedOnboarding=true, theme="dark", bypassPermissionsModeAccepted=true, and projects["/workspace"].{hasTrustDialogAccepted=true, hasCompletedProjectOnboarding=true}. (2) EDIT `.devcontainer/Dockerfile`: add `COPY .devcontainer/claude-config.json /home/bun/.claude.json` immediately BEFORE the `ARG HOST_UID=1000` line (currently ~line 49). NO `--chown` flag and NO extra chown line — the existing CAM-178 re-home block `chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /home/bun` (~line 57) re-owns it to the host uid (Docker docs confirmed: COPY defaults to root:root, a later chown -R re-owns). A `COPY --chown=bun:bun` would bind to bun's pre-usermod uid 1000, wrong after the re-home. (3) NEW test `test/supervisor/claude-config-bake.test.ts`: mirror `test/supervisor/worker-container-git-cred.test.ts` (readFileSync file-asserts, no Docker daemon; CI runs macos-latest with no Docker). Assert COPY-before-ARG ordering via `dockerfile.indexOf('claude-config.json') < dockerfile.indexOf('ARG HOST_UID')`. GOTCHAS (grill spec + patterns.md): onboarding/trust state lives in the EPHEMERAL /home/bun/.claude.json (a FILE at the container home), NOT in the claude-code-config volume (which mounts the /home/bun/.claude DIRECTORY) — it resets on every container recreate, so it MUST be baked into the image, never persisted via the volume. Seeding top-level hasCompletedOnboarding ALONE does NOT suppress the /workspace trust prompt (CAM-175 empirical); projects["/workspace"].hasTrustDialogAccepted=true is REQUIRED (schema verified against the host ~/.claude.json). Do NOT edit worker-container.ts or ensure-container.ts — the bake changes NO run-argv; the `--mount source=claude-code-config,target=/home/bun/.claude,type=volume` line stays exactly as-is. Do NOT seed lastOnboardingVersion speculatively (add only if the operator ceremony surfaces version-gated re-onboarding vs the pinned CLI @2.1.197). `.devcontainer/` is NOT embedded/vendored (see the git-cred test header), so no embed-vendor step is needed; check:all still runs the full spine. Read scripts/cam/patterns.md before coding. OUT OF SCOPE: the operator-ceremony live prompt-suppression check via interactive `docker exec -it ... claude --agent` (requires a real image rebuild + Docker, unavailable in CI) is hand-filed by the operator via /cam-issue and is NOT part of this PRD; CAM-176 (firewall wiring) and the full CAM-175 end-to-end re-run are separate. Note for a future CAM-177 lander: its .dockerignore MUST NOT exclude .devcontainer/claude-config.json.
